description: This HTML file is a frontend test interface for a subtitle synchronization platform. It contains UI elements and JavaScript functions to test backend API connectivity, file uploads (video and subtitle files), correction, and generation functionalities.

methods.name: logResult
methods.description: Logs messages with timestamp and specified type to the results panel.

methods.name: testConnection
methods.description: Tests the API backend connection by sending a GET request and updating the UI based on response.

methods.name: testCorrection
methods.description: Uploads video and subtitle files to test correction process, displays and provides the corrected file for download.

methods.name: testGeneration
methods.description: Uploads a video file to test subtitle generation, displays and provides the generated subtitle file for download.
